dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: The publishing industry makes no money. I'd best seek out some new investment ventures...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any recommended reads?

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: They're all here, have a look.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to tabulate my investment returns.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Oh, you're back. Unfortunately, it isn't time for that yet — you can only tabulate your returns on a weekly basis. Please come back next week.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to tabulate my investment returns.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Oh hoho, well, if it isn't our regular client? Have you checked on your profit-loss ratios from your previous investments? Don't worry, there's no rush.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What investments?

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: 2,000 Mora for a single investment coupon. These coupons can be used to claim returns each time an investment tenure concludes.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Losses and gains are both to be expected when it comes to investment, of course, but I've made quite a tidy sum from this portfolio. How about it, want to join in?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happened to your publishing business?

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Bah! Such meager profits — how am I supposed to pay off my debts? And that's not counting the losses from my investments in Sumeru, or the equipment costs I incurred in Fontaine... Ugh.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: And that's saying nothing of how cunning people here are. They'll read a few pages today, leave, come back tomorrow, read another few... And in no time at all, they'll read the whole book for free! Of course, that only happens when I'm not watching.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: And others complain that the Nasha Express is full of ads... Yeah, cool, but does it look like I can change that?!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: You're not buying anything? Fine...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> appears to be interested in the investment coupons...)

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: You again? I'm not selling investment coupons anymore. Go on, off with you.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Hah... should've known better than to believe you'd have any friends to bring in...

choices.text: Hey, you were the one scamming people.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Wouldn't selling books honestly be better?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh! Hey, {NICKNAME}, look over there! That book looks interesting. Let's go check it out.

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: Alright, alright... guess it's just my bad luck...

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: L–Lady Nefer! What an unexpected honor... Would you perhaps like to buy an investment — uh, I mean, a book?

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Oh, no, I'll pass. I'm just here with my friend to have a look around.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: I've heard your investments have been thriving, Mr. Dhabit. Seeing it with my own eyes, I can see the rumor holds true.

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: Oh, it's nothing, nothing, haha... just a small venture to make ends meet.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Ah, Mr. Dhabit, you're too modest. Your reputation and business acumen are well known in Nasha Town.

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: I'm certain that with everyone investing through you, you'll make a tidy fortune yourself.

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: Thank you for the kind words, Lady Nefer...

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: And, about that matter I asked your help with last time...

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: We've found what you're looking for, but...

response.speaker: Nefer
response.text: Do have patience, Mr. Dhabit. One step at a time — that's how proper business is done.

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: O—Oh yes, you're right, of course... I'll leave it in your capable hands...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> appears to be interested in the investment coupons...)

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: You again? I'm not selling investment coupons anymore. Go on, off with you.

dialogues.speaker: Dhabit
dialogues.text: Hah... should've known better than to believe you'd have any friends to bring in...

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Heh, looks like your investment business is doing really well, Boss Dhabit.

response.speaker: Dhabit
response.text: Oh, it's nothing, nothing, haha... just a small venture to make ends meet.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Oh, please don't sell yourself short, Boss Dhabit. Boss Nef says that Boss Dhabit is the most reputable AND the most capable businessman.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: She's confident that anyone who invests with you will make a tidy fortune.

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: Oh. Boss said, "We've located what you're looking for."

response.speaker: Jahoda
response.text: "Do have patience, Mr. Dhabit. One step at a time — that's how proper business is done."
